Home.heroDesc: The ultimate solution to orchestrate your schedule 24/7, ensure absolute precision in commission calculations, and assume total command of your cash flow.
Home.heroDescStrong: More time for your craft, impeccable management for your success.
Home.painTitle: Still wasting time with a paper appointment book?
Home.painDesc: If your client can't book from their phone on a Sunday night, they'll go to your competitor. We deliver the digital convenience your salon deserves.
Home.benefit1Desc: Say goodbye to late nights answering messages. Your online booking link works for you 24/7, while you rest.
Home.benefit2Desc: View your schedule with total clarity. Avoid gaps, overlaps, and achieve the organization of a high-level salon.
Home.benefit3Desc: Closed the register? The system delivers every professional's exact calculation instantly. Transparency and peace of mind.
Home.featuresTitle: A complete arsenal for your business
Home.featuresDesc: Don't hire 3 different systems. AgendarPro brings everything you need in one intuitive platform.
Home.feat1Desc: Manage your entire salon directly from your phone. Clients can also book via mobile with total ease.
Home.feat2Desc: Visual Control. See gaps and conflicts instantly.
Home.feat3Desc: Know exactly what color or cut the client had last time.
Home.feat4Desc: Average ticket, top services and daily profit projections.
Home.feat5Desc: Automatic and error-proof calculation for your entire team.
Home.feat6Desc: Access restrictions: each collaborator only sees their own schedule.
Home.plansDesc: Start free. Upgrade when you need to grow. Cancel anytime.
Home.planFreeDesc: To get started and explore the platform.
Home.planBasicDesc: For growing salons that want professionalism.
Home.planPremiumDesc: No limits. For those who take their business seriously.
Home.plansNote: All plans include email technical support. No credit card for the free plan.
Home.ctaTitle: The decision that changes your revenue.
Home.ctaDesc: Every day without an organized system is another client going to the competitor because they couldn't book quickly.
Home.ctaDescStrong: How long will you leave money on the table?
Home.ctaNote: Takes less than 2 minutes to set up. No credit card.
